# sfAlex

> sfAlex is the personal website of Alex Rom, an entrepreneur and engineer based in San Francisco.

The site covers technology ventures, engineering and product building, entrepreneurship, and technology communities. Content describes projects Alex is building, growing, and supporting; inclusion does not assert legal ownership or founder status.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sfalex.com/): Profile and current ventures.
- [About Alex](https://sfalex.com/about/): Professional profile and areas of focus.
- [Projects and ventures](https://sfalex.com/ventures/): Eight-project directory.
- [Experience and expertise](https://sfalex.com/experience/): Engineering, entrepreneurship, and community.
